patch_description:
Key design choices vs seed:
1. Two staggered CZ entangling layers (even-pair ring + odd-pair ring) instead of just a line, giving better connectivity across all qubits
2. Two trainable CRZ gates on diagonal qubit pairs (0↔4, 2↔6) to learn fine-grained two-qubit phase correlations beyond fixed CZ gates
3. Sandwiched RY+RZ → CZ_even → RY → CZ_odd+CRZ → RZ structure provides full SU(2) expressibility per qubit with entanglement interleaved
4. 34 parameters per block × 6 instances (l=3, p=2) = 204 + 2 (gain/bias) = 206 total - moderate count to avoid barren plateaus while maintaining expressibility
5. The ring+diagonal topology ensures every qubit can correlate with every other within 2 hops, improving gradient flow
